# Steady Lynx 98 — exact P9-XG20 handoff

**Verdict: exact complete-`Y1`-star-turnover nonwinner.** I did not obtain a homogeneous convex polyhedral Gömböc. I exactified `P9-XG20-Y1FS6-RC5-E15`, an actual uniform-density convex polyhedron at its own ordinary-volume centroid with strict `(S,U,H)=(2,2,2)`. It destroys the complete old `Y1` star and remote packet, but a new forcing edge `YT4-YT5` survives.

Authority: immutable parent `figure-0286`, SHA-256 `1d67cd35d55d757b347f5d0d7d4917fc800209543cada19223cdbd38f0273cec`. No conflict was found with the literal payload or durable journal. 

The proposed ten-row/four-cell model was superseded by a smaller stronger realization: six new rows enter, while the entire 15-vertex active dual is a connected nonannular 3-ball split into four mutually overlapping positive-volume subcomplexes with five internally vertex-disjoint target/return routes.

This is a complete deterministic exact H/V generator; no tolerance selects incidence.
